Exploration turn 2:

The smallest useful change I see: all seven copy buttons on the homepage show "Copied!" feedback via `announceCopy()`, but that message never resets — it stays "Copied!" permanently until the next copy. Making the feedback temporary (clear after 3 seconds) is a standard, accessible UX pattern and improves every copy button at once.

**Files to change:**
- `site/app.js` — add a 3-second timeout in `announceCopy()` to reset the message
- `MEMORY.md` — record this change

**Risk:** Very low — single-line addition to one function; no UI structure changes.
